desc:
Pine Ridge is a cozy small town that's nestled in some frigid forgotten part of the U.S. A single stretch of road connects everyone together, and the gloomy weather greets all types of characters; visitors and residents alike. 
 
This is a freeform roleplay.
Inspired by Toast22A's "Clear Skies Over Milwaukee" & Stranger Things.

⭐Join the group for in-game benefits, such as the Backpack and Rides library!⭐

We have a lot of systems to use within our game and it can be a bit overwhelming; we recommend players to experiment with them at their own pace. 
⌛ If you're lagging. Go to our settings menu (Top left) and disable Diffuse and Specular in the Graphics tab, RPNames, and even SurfaceAppearances. 
❌ While this game has access to VR and Console enabled, it doesn't have any support in regards to gameplay features. 

';chatlogs true'
